children: was raised to Buy from Hold at Texas Capital Securities, citing that the AI disintermediation concerns are overblown.
The price target was reduced to $66.00 from $80.00. Shares were 1.94% higher at $45.25 during pre-market trading on Tuesday.
"Goosehead Insurance shares sold off 21% last week and underperformed insurance distribution peers by 25% trailing 1 mo. and 39% TTM," said analyst Randy Binner.

"The primary cause of this has been market fears of disintermediation risk presented by Meta Muse, an AI assistant that automates shopping and service-provider comparisons. We believe the market is overestimating the potential disruption for insurance distributors, and GSHD in particular," said the research note.

The investment bank said not all insurers may choose to appoint mass market digital agents like Muse. Also, insurers may not choose to share their proprietary pricing models with AI systems. Besides, AI searches are mostly going to funnel to traditional underwriting platforms, while state regulators worry over consumers getting "quotes" from an unlicensed virtual agent.
Given GSHD's recent underperformance to peers, the new price target implies a 49% return to target in Texas Capital's valuation methodology.
